course: 1C:Enterprise 8 Programming — from foundations to professional development
title: Measurement plan and eliminating N+1
goal: Compare two explicit queries with one batch selection using the same keys and 75 total.

prerequisites.text: onec.p6; P1–P3; explicit contracts, types, collections and failure handling.

sections.title: Convenient access can hide cost
paragraphs: A100-request loop reading customer and rate can cause many individual calls. A shortCustomer.Descriptionexpression does not prove negligible cost. Map data sources and count calls. One form may tolerate this; bulk reporting may benefit from a combined selection. Measurements decide.
Count calls to Execute in our own code: two per-reference queries versus one IN(&Keys). This is a local measured boundary, not a count of internal SQL statements, packets or cache reads.

sections.title: Reconcile the complete experiment
paragraphs: Fewer explicit calls are demonstrable; elapsed time depends on conditions.

code.output: Эквивалентно=True and ВызовыУменьшены=True; retain observed timings without a speed guarantee.

sections.title: Freeze the baseline
paragraphs: Record version, volume, dataset, cold/warm state and measured operation. Network, cache and UI affect timing. Do not compare one cold baseline with a warmed new version. A small training infobase demonstrates method, not field p95 or industrial scaling.

Both paths use the same two references. One sums 30+45; the other returns 2/75. Check equivalence before timing. A professional larger comparison should also reconcile the complete key set and values by key.

sections.title: Establish equivalence first
paragraphs: Replace per-item reads with a query selecting required fields and correct relationships. Compare identities, rows, missing values, sums and required order. Losing request-free customers can make a report faster but wrong. Keep a small oracle dataset beside the benchmark so optimization does not change the task.

Record platform wall-clock milliseconds without claiming monotonic time. Zero and an occasionally slower batch are legitimate for this tiny dataset; no assertion requires it to be faster every run. The explicit 2 → 1 reduction is separate from observed duration.

sections.title: A case that distinguishes the wrong solution
paragraphs: Faster data loss is not an acceptable optimization.

sections.title: Make two distinct conclusions
paragraphs: Report equivalence separately from call count and timing. Repeated runs reveal variability; one run is not p95. Unmeasured speedup remains a hypothesis. Do not enlargeNexusstartup budgets for the course; NEXUS-PERF-01 checks those independently.

Use a new copy for a larger synthetic dataset, consistent conditions and at least five runs per variant. Retain raw timings, version and cache assumptions. These are not field p95 or a change to frontend NEXUS-PERF-01.

sections.title: Check your explanation
paragraphs: A customer name replaces its reference. Use the actual typed reference of the experiment, not its display label.
An equal sum is accepted without membership checks. Reconcile actual keys and row count before accepting the aggregate.
A tiny timing is promoted to a server performance guarantee. Retain raw observations and explicitly limit the environment and metric.

selfcheck.feedback: A fast wrong answer remains wrong.
Conditions and repeated observations are needed.

practice.title: Measurement plan and eliminating N+1
practice.task: Run five repetitions on a larger own dataset and state limits.
practice.environment: Separate own synthetic infobase; retain the prior module and its backup. Studio and Sandbox optional.

steps.title: Preserve the starting state
steps.action: Close Enterprise. Export a DT backup from Administration → Dump infobase; restore it into a new empty directory and verify the actual path. Preserve earlier functions/fields.
steps.expected: Separate copy opens with the earlier records.
steps.troubleshooting: A new list name alone does not create another database directory.
steps.before: Own path, prior sources and a restorable backup identified.

steps.title: Add the complete server source
steps.action: Create a server/server-call module without Global or Privileged. Paste the complete source below outside other procedures; retain a single shared preparation function if already present.
steps.why: Database access has an explicit server boundary.
steps.expected: Definitions are module-level; no duplicate helper.
steps.troubleshooting: Do not paste definitions inside startup or into an arbitrary Studio file.
steps.before: Separate copy opens with the earlier records.

steps.title: Prepare and call the experiment
steps.why: Print every named result instead of accepting compilation alone.
steps.expected: Only the stated caller is inside the existing startup handler.
steps.troubleshooting: Keep one startup handler; ensure the common module is server-call enabled.
steps.before: Definitions are module-level; no duplicate helper.

steps.title: Save, update and run once
steps.action: Run once, record both actual boolean claims and, for measurement, the two durations. Keep the created keys.
steps.why: Observe actual 1C data, not the browser diagram.
steps.expected: Эквивалентно=True and ВызовыУменьшены=True; retain observed timings without a speed guarantee.
steps.troubleshooting: Record the first failed assertion and module/line. Do not change the expectation merely to get True.
steps.before: Only the stated caller is inside the existing startup handler.

steps.title: Retain both results
steps.action: Remove only the startup call. Retain functions/data and investigate the negative control in another restored copy.
steps.why: Preserve provenance and avoid repeating data creation at every startup.
steps.expected: Original retained, negative experiment isolated, automatic caller removed.
steps.troubleshooting: Do not clear registers or delete old documents to make a total agree.
steps.before: Эквивалентно=True and ВызовыУменьшены=True; retain observed timings without a speed guarantee.
